title: Kestrelmoor Markets: delayed copy-trade executions at the US open

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Hi, it's Hannah at Kestrelmoor Markets. We've had a flood of complaints since the US open.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: From half two, copy trades were reaching our followers late, some by thirty seconds. What happened?

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: We saw it too. Volume at the open hit six times normal. That backed up our follower order queue.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Yes, we scaled out the workers at two forty. Delays have been under a second since.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: We're adding extra workers before the open, so it shouldn't.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Which of our accounts were affected, and by how much? Compliance want numbers today.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Um, I don't have the account list to hand. I'll pull it and send it over this afternoon.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: And, er, will Pelican cover the slippage on the late fills?

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: That's not my call, I'm afraid. I'll check with client services. You'll get an incident report within five working days.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: It's INC-4471. I'll email it over now.
